preview_no_settings_or_files_were_change: Preview: no settings or files were changed.
backups_saves_proton_wine_components_ben: Backups, saves, Proton, Wine components, benchmarks and MangoHUD appearance are preserved.
removes_managed_mods_and_packages_uninst: Removes managed mods and packages, uninstalls DLSSNR-AMD, disables MAKO/overlay and clears performance, launch and advanced settings. Unknown files may remain.
backups_are_preserved_along_with_wine_co: Backups are preserved, along with Wine components, Proton, benchmarks and MangoHUD appearance. Mods that affect saves may require a compatible save after removal.
reset_mods_0_description: Removes managed mods and downloaded packages, restoring tracked original files. Unknown or externally modified files may require manual intervention.
reset_dlss_0_description: Uninstalls DLSSNR-AMD and removes its managed launch settings.
reset_frame_generation_0_description: Disables MAKO for this game. Shared components remain available to other games.
reset_performance_0_description: Returns this game's overlay and MangoHUD to the defaults, following the global switches, and removes its FPS limits, including the Gamescope limiter. MangoHUD appearance and benchmarks are preserved.
reset_options_0_description: Clears typed launch options, DLL priorities and the Steam client bridge. Lines of mods that stay installed, such as DLSSNR-AMD, are kept. Preserves the selected Proton and installed prefix components.
reset_advanced_0_description: Turns off the Advanced tab switches, including GameMode, CPU priority, shader cache and OBS capture, plus Gamescope and custom wrappers. Preserves launch options, DLL priorities, per-game monitoring and MAKO settings. Commands entered manually in Options may still enable features.
reset_all_0_description: Applies all resets above to this installation only. Does not reinstall or delete the game or prefix.
